features: hard carrier, directory, fundraiser, vendor, article, travel, social and reference rejection
independent site-root ownership crosscheck for every deep or query URL
current-rule revalidation of every retained or historical URL regardless of its old label
known official fetch failure preservation instead of directory replacement
explicit parent/project and controlled hosted-microsite verification
three-layer safety enforcement: candidate verifier, final result guard and deterministic Avika-export rebuild
permanent NGO IDs and immutable source-record IDs
resumable checkpoints and optional selective Firecrawl
status endpoint hotfix: persisted ok field no longer causes duplicate-keyword 500
notes: Production starts directly with RUN_01; the external 44-NGO test is not a gate.
Use SERPER_CONCURRENCY=4 initially. SERPER_API_KEYS is ignored.
No separate mutation token is used; ADMIN_PASSWORD is the only credential.
Use Frontend v159 so browser polling and exports go through the same-origin proxy.
